Our founding story

Three paths. One shared commitment.

Raju, Shyam and Mak arrived at SetuHashi through different experiences—in Japan, India and around the world—but shared a commitment to contribute to two countries that matter deeply to them: India and Japan.

Changing international relationships and a desire for a new entrepreneurial chapter prompted them to consider what they could build together.

Longstanding personal connections brought them into conversation. When the three met in Bengaluru, that shared ambition became the basis for SetuHashi.

Research and early business conversations gave that ambition a practical direction: helping Japanese and Indian businesses turn complementary strengths into opportunities.

  • Raju

    Raju brought his Japanese upbringing, Indian roots and extensive US experience in sales and customer service.

  • Shyam

    Shyam brought entrepreneurship and relationships across India’s business ecosystems.

  • Mak

    Mak brought cross-border entrepreneurship and global experience in business growth and transformation.
